{{Quote|Welcome to Project Hexapod. Not much, is it? Just me and a couple of obselete computers.|Doctor Revis|<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Project Hexapod|[[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]}}</ref>}}
'''Project Hexapod''' was a scientific initiative sponsored by the [[Imperial Science Bureau (Sith Empire)|Imperial Science Bureau]] during the time of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Its creation came during the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] invasion of the planet [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. At the time, [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Revis]] of the Science Bureau was charged with the completion of the project that aimed to study the effects of the experiments that led to the weaponization of the the [[mutant]] [[Colicoid/Legends|Colicoids]].<ref name="TOR" />
